messages.text: Severe peanut allergy. Just so we're clear from the jump.
Got it — peanuts in any form. I'll keep them out.
Want to expand my soup repertoire. Something warming for fall weeknights.

## West African Groundnut Stew

Deeply nourishing, warming, comes together in about 40 minutes.

**Ingredients**
- 1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
- 1 onion, diced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 1 tbsp tomato paste
- 1 sweet potato, cubed
- 4 cups chicken stock
- ½ cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 can crushed tomatoes
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- ½ tsp cayenne
- Bunch of kale, chopped
- Cilantro and crushed peanuts to garnish

**Method**
Brown the chicken in a heavy pot. Add onion, garlic, ginger, sauté 5 min. Stir in tomato paste and spices. Add stock, tomatoes, sweet potato. Simmer 15 min. Whisk in the peanut butter. Add kale, cook 5 more min. Top with cilantro and crushed peanuts. Serve over rice.
